items.title: What Does Bending Spoons (BSP) Mean With A $3.68 Billion Deal And $1.3 Billion Raise?
items.summary: Bending Spoons (NasdaqGS:BSP) agreed to acquire Mailchimp from Intuit for US$3.68b, according to a joint announcement. The deal transfers the Mailchimp email and marketing automation platform and related assets from Intuit to Bending Spoons. Bending Spoons announced a US$1.3b private placement with institutional investors to support the Mailchimp transaction and broader plans. items.title: Intuit (INTU) Stock Price Slides As Q1 Results Meet Slower Growth Fears
items.summary: Intuit just released Q1 FY2027 numbers that looked solid on paper, yet the stock still sank about 13% today to roughly US$270. The software group delivered about US$4.4b in revenue and basic earnings per share of about US$2.60, figures that align with a profitable, mature platform rather than a broken story. items.title: Intuit Sinks 13% on Revenue Guidance Cut as CEO Calls AI Tools “New Front Doors for Discovery”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysIntuit shares fell 13% after it cut its fiscal 2027 revenue growth guidance to 8%-9%, as Credit Karma’s outlook dropped to 3%-7% growth from 11%-13%. Management blamed higher rates and a faster-than-expected shift to AI tools.
